title: Wyoming Trail
A road-trip RPG across modern Wyoming.
Lander to Yellowstone — fuel, food, four friends, and one pickup.
gas_station_attendant: Fill 'er up, travelers. Price is on the sign, and the sign is a liar.
Take your time — the road out here is longer in the mirror than it looks.
ranger_high_country: Watch for high-wind gusts on the pass. Ease off when the mirror shakes.
You're doing fine. The mountain will clear before the afternoon.
ranger_park_gate: Welcome to Yellowstone. You made it all the way — that's the whole game.
Remember: bison are always right, on the road and off it.
